description: This file implements a Bonjour service resolver for the Gateway module, using NetService to resolve network service addresses without relying on TXT records. It defines the GatewayServiceResolver class which manages service discovery and resolution callbacks.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Final class responsible for resolving Bonjour network services using NetService, providing callback with host and port information once resolved.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with service details and a completion callback, setting up the NetService delegate.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the service resolution process with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate method called when the service has been successfully resolved; extracts host and port, then calls finish.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate method called when resolution fails; triggers finish with nil result.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Completes the resolution process, ensures single completion, stops the service, and invokes the completion handler.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static method to normalize host names using support functions.
